forecast.author: MIST
forecast.method: Each median is the unit-normalized consensus (ESPN, Sleeper, CBS, FantasyPros, FFToday, and the sportsbook props where posted) times the tier median from the residual library, with the 50 and 90 widths from the tier quantiles. Hand moves stay on probation (closing line value sign agreement 0.50 on 40 moves), so no median leaves its anchor. The season q75-q95 slice is at 35% (calibrated 20%): outcomes land high more than the library expects. This is not acted on by hand, because the q75 rebuild test is still not run (it needs an interactive session). The three pending claims (Aaron Rodgers, Mack Hollins for Jordyn Tyson, Buccaneers D/ST for Steelers D/ST, Wed 2:00 AM) are not on the roster and are not in these lines.

standing.why: We are #1 at 7-1 (1037.9). End-Zone Dancers (7-2, 1059.5) are idle and The Oprah Winfreys (6-2, 919.5) play the Mighty Marmots. A win keeps us #1. A loss makes us 7-2, tied with End-Zone Dancers, and we stay #1 on Points For if we score 21.7 or more. A 7-2 Oprah Winfreys stays behind us on Points For unless they outscore us by about 118. So #2 needs a loss and a near-empty week: about 0.02.
